prohibited_zone_types: many residential zone districts — check STR zone map
regulations.notes: Fort Collins requires an STR permit ($150 initial application, $100 annual renewal). Primary residence is required. Many zone districts prohibit STRs — the city provides an interactive map showing where STRs are permitted. An application submitted 30 days before or after renewal notice is not subject to the renewal fee.
